trial_index.Description: Monotonic index of trials kept in beh.tsv (practice removed).

blockcode.Description: Inquisit block label; main task typically "backward_block".

stimulus.Description: Presented digit sequence for the trial.

error_count.Description: Number of mismatches between response and correct response.

mean_length.Description: Running average of correctly recalled sequence length (ML).

Instructions: Recall each presented sequence in reverse order by clicking digits.
